name: Удар молотом
subject: A leather-gloved hand with teal sleeve swings a heavy SQUARE steel forge hammer with brass bands on a securely aligned brown wood handle. Broad flat striking FACE contacts a broken wood-and-stone brace at lower right; short gold contact sparks and small teal repair motes rise from restored joints. Hammer solid weight, handle connects centrally to head, no speed coming from grip. Navy/teal backdrop.
caption: Тяжёлый молот и искры в точке удара; бирюзовые частицы напоминают о ремонте.
